Chrumë is a mushroom found in underground environments of western Endor under cool temperate conditions. It is moderately difficult to find in its habitat.

Eaten directly, this mushroom produces euphoria and stimulation for several hours. It reduces Agility and Quickness by about 20 points while increasing Constitution and Presence by about 20 points. The user may become engrossed in insignificant details. Repeated consumption carries a risk of habituation.
